messages:
anna_sales: Heads-up: ACME procurement needs our SOC 2 Type II, a signed mutual NDA, and a one-page bridge attestation for a 2-week Dedicated POC. Deadline: EOD Friday. Can Legal + Security take point?

ben_security: We have a 2025 SOC 2 Type II report covering hosted inference. Link (security access only): https://drive.internal.redwood/soc2/2025-type2.pdf. Need to confirm which controls ACME wants mapped.

dana_legal: I can fire off a mutual NDA via DocuSign now. For the bridge attestation, we'll reference the SOC report and list the controls we cover for Dedicated. @ben_security please confirm encryption/KMS and logging details.

ben_security: Confirm: encryption at rest (customer KMS option on Dedicated), TLS in transit, tenant isolation for Dedicated, and audit logging (90-day default retention). Private/on-prem requires customer-managed controls; we can only provide guidance.

chris_eng: POC notes: Dedicated provisioning needs a short infra window and an IP allowlist from ACME. If they plan to upload model weights or sample data with licensing constraints, send legal the details. We need 48 hrs to spin up once approved.

lina_pricing: Pricing options: PAYG est ~$4k for 2 weeks; short-term reserved bucket 30% off (~$2.8k). I posted a short offer doc to internal pricing links. Open to a custom quoted line item.

anna_sales: Procurement insists on NDA before we share SOC/CAIQ. Legal sent NDA (DocuSign). I'll push ACME to sign today. Target: SOC + CAIQ + bridge letter shared tomorrow AM once NDA done; pricing + provisioning options by tomorrow PM.

ben_security: Also preparing a CAIQ export and a mapping doc that ties CAIQ answers back to SOC sections. Will redact internal-only notes. Sharing after NDA.

dana_legal: Draft bridge attestation: one page referencing SOC report, noting controls applicable to Dedicated and clarifying customer responsibilities for Private deployments and physical access. I'll include language about not expanding warranty beyond SOC coverage.

anna_sales: Great. I'll collect ACME's billing contact and allowlist IPs. Will update when DocuSign completes.
